models_evaluated: multiple frontier LLMs (not named in the text)

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM differential diagnoses across benign rephrasings of patient queries
links.effect: Prompt-level factors shifted model behavior along clinically meaningful dimensions. Neutralization increased plausibility and conciseness but reduced coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions. No numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: We also study perturbation regimes that capture routine input variation and show that prompt-level factors shift model behavior along clinically meaningful dimensions.

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic output sensitivity to realistic non-adversarial input variation
links.effect: Benign input variation shifted outputs, tracing Pareto-like tradeoffs across multiple frontier LLMs. Neutralization reduced coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions.
links.quote: Across multiple frontier LLMs, these shifts trace out Pareto-like tradeoffs.

unlisted_practices: Neutralizing user-level factors in prompts while preserving clinical content
User-facing guidance on prompt phrasing derived from benign-perturbation evaluation (Green Shielding / CUE criteria)

screen.practice: input neutralization of patient queries (prompt-level rephrasing)
screen.reason: Empirically tests prompt-level perturbation/neutralization guardrails designed for safer deployment on real patient queries and evaluates clinical safety tradeoffs on frontier LLMs.
